docs.text: This page contains some of my educational projects completed during the Introduction in Web Technologies course.

docs.title: Laboratory Work 1 — Docker Basics
docs.text: In this laboratory work, I learned the basics of Docker and containerization.

docs.title: Technologies
docs.text:
• Docker
  • Nginx
  • Ubuntu
  • Docker Volumes

docs.title: Main Tasks
docs.text:
• Installed Docker
  • Ran the hello-world container
  • Launched an Nginx web server
  • Managed Docker images and containers
  • Worked with Docker volumes

Example command:

docker run -d -p 8080:80 --name web-server nginx:alpine

View laboratory works on GitHub

docs.title: Laboratory Work 2 — Docker Flask Application
docs.text: In this project, I created a simple web application using Python and Flask and packaged it into a Docker image.

docs.title: Technologies
docs.text:
• Python
  • Flask
  • Docker
  • Dockerfile

The application displays:

Hello from Docker CI/CD!

Main stages of the project:

  1. Created a Flask application.
  2. Added project dependencies.
  3. Created a Dockerfile.
  4. Built a Docker image.
  5. Ran the application inside a container.
